Pre-Condition: Browser is open and SauceDemo login page is accessible
Test Steps: 1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/ ; 2. Enter standard_user in Username ; 3. Enter secret_sauce in Password ; 4. Click Login button
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the Products page

Test Steps: 1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/ ; 2. Enter wrong_user in Username ; 3. Enter wrong_pass in Password ; 4. Click Login button
Expected Result: Error message should be displayed and user should remain on the login page

Test Case: Verify validation when login fields are empty
Test Steps: 1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/ ; 2. Leave both Username and Password empty ; 3. Click Login button
Expected Result: Error message Username is required should be displayed

Test Case: Verify that all products are displayed with correct details
Test Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials ; 2. Observe the Products page ; 3. Check product names prices and images
Expected Result: All 6 products should be displayed with names prices and images

Test Case: Verify that a product can be added to the cart
Test Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials ; 2. Click Add to Cart on Sauce Labs Backpack ; 3. Observe the cart badge count
Expected Result: Cart badge count should increase to 1

Test Case: Verify that the added product appears in the cart
Test Steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon ; 2. Observe the product listed in the cart
Expected Result: Sauce Labs Backpack should be displayed in the cart with price $29.99

Test Case: Verify that a product can be removed from the cart
Test Steps: 1. Open the cart ; 2. Click Remove button for the product
Expected Result: Product should be removed and the cart badge should disappear

Test Case: Verify that the checkout information form is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Open the cart ; 2. Click Checkout button ; 3. Observe the form
Expected Result: First Name Last Name and Zip or Postal Code fields should be displayed

Test Case: Verify that the sorting dropdown works correctly
Test Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials ; 2. Click the sorting dropdown ; 3. Select Price low to high ; 4. Observe the product order
Expected Result: Products should be rearranged from lowest price to highest price

Test Case: Verify that the user can log out successfully
Test Steps: 1. Click the hamburger menu icon ; 2. Click Logout
Expected Result: User should be logged out and returned to the login page
